behavior_change_from_previous: a minor release on 0.28.0: the configuration registry moves from 27 to 28, the execution plan from 11 to 12, the daemon IPC schema from 10 to 11, the job manifest and summary from 2 to 3, and the plan report from 1 to 2; every other counter is 0.28.0's (configuration schema 6, command record 3, credential package 2, scoreboard 3, audit 1); a job runs under its client's configuration, sent in the plan's configuration block, and the plan carries no copy of a key; a job's audit records, the cancel record included, go to the sinks its configuration names, and the daemon opens no audit sink of its own; the manifest's policy block and the readiness policy_digest removed; path-valued keys made absolute when the configuration loads (config_working_directory_unavailable; crun_directory_unavailable retired); the reload class says which keys wait for a daemon restart; the packaged user units carry no file-system sandbox and the daemon's drop-in example is removed; crun_directory_not_writable names its cause; a running 0.28.0 daemon is compatible: false by its version and its IPC schema and is restarted; see CHANGELOG.md

build.dependencies: vendored (go.mod, go.sum, vendor/); built with no network

daemon_upgrade_recovery.actual_lifecycle_replay: passed against the released v0.28.0 executable (daemon IPC 10, this client 11): status compatible: false, the run refused with daemon_incompatible without replacing the daemon, stop with no option, restart, and stop with --force, --grace, and --after (evidence/v0280-to-v0290-lifecycle.log); the compatibility example ran before the number was committed: the released v0.28.0 daemon reported compatible: false to this client on the version and the IPC schema, refused its run with daemon_incompatible before any job, and was stopped by the client (evidence/ipc-schema-compat.log)
